doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Shares of Chiken Techno Co., Ltd. (Full Subsidiary Status)
doc_title_jp: 地研テクノ株式会社の株式取得（完全子会社化）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 中期経営計画に基づく成長投資。基礎・地盤改良分野における顧客基盤、技術、人財および施工体制を拡充し、中長期的な収益力と企業価値の向上を図る。

summary_en: Nittoc Construction acquired all issued shares of Chiken Techno Co., Ltd. for a strategic expansion of its foundation and ground improvement business. The acquisition, executed through a share purchase agreement on September 28, 2026, combines Nittoc's nationwide infrastructure and expertise with Chiken Techno's customer base and specialized capabilities in residential and low-rise building foundation work.
summary_jp: 日特建設が地研テクノの発行済株式全てを取得し、完全子会社化する。基礎・地盤改良分野における顧客基盤、技術、人財および施工体制を拡充し、住宅・低層建築分野への事業展開と中長期的な収益力向上を図る戦略的な成長投資。
tag_en: Acquisition of Chiken Techno for full subsidiary status
tag_jp: 地研テクノの完全子会社化
